items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend.
items.claim: The text says the LORD spoke to Moses face to face, the way a man speaks to his friend.
items.mechanism: direct face-to-face speech, likened to talking with a friend

items.quote: And he turned again into the camp
items.claim: The text says Moses went back into the camp.

items.quote: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
items.claim: The text says Moses's servant Joshua, son of Nun, a young man, stayed in the tabernacle and did not leave it.
items.mechanism: stayed behind while Moses went back to the camp
